name: Virginia
notes: Virginia supports digital ID through Apple Wallet and the VA MiD app. Google Wallet and Samsung Wallet are not currently supported.

wallets.name: Apple Wallet
steps: Open the Wallet app on your iPhone.
Tap the + button in the top-right corner.
Follow the onscreen instructions to scan your Virginia driver's license or ID and verify your identity.
Once approved by the Virginia DMV, your ID will be available in Apple Wallet on your iPhone and any paired Apple Watch.

wallets.name: VA MiD
steps: Download the VA MiD app from the App Store or Google Play.
Create or sign in to your Virginia DMV account.
Follow the in-app prompts to scan the front and back of your Virginia driver's license or ID.
Your Mobile ID will be available in the app once approved by the Virginia DMV.
